name: Oletheme Cleaning Cost Calculator
author: Olena

sections.description:
Cleaning Service Cost Calculator is the easiest way to give your visitors instant cleaning price estimates without writing a single line of code.
Perfect for cleaning companies, agencies, or freelancers — show professionalism and transparency by letting customers calculate their costs directly on your website.

✨ Key highlights:
– Fully customizable service list and pricing.
– Easy integration via shortcode.
– Responsive design that works on any device.
– Lightweight and fast — no extra bloat.

With this plugin, you save time answering repetitive pricing questions and your clients get instant answers. Win–win!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/cleaning-cost-calculator directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Add your services and prices in the plugin settings.
  4. Place the shortcode [ccalc_cleaning_calculator] on any page or post.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the services and prices?

Yes, everything is editable in the plugin settings.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Absolutely! The calculator is responsive and adapts to any screen size.

Do I need coding knowledge to use this plugin?

Not at all. Just install, configure your prices, and paste the shortcode.
